messages:
ana: FYI Acme Bank sent a full SIG (v3) and asked for question-by-question evidence. They want a package by EOD Fri. Can we triage and split ownership?

mike: I can take infra/security controls (Q1-Q85). I'll need KMS policy, key rotation proof, and a network diagram.

sophia: I'll own app/deploy/runtime (Q86-Q170). I'll sketch the deployment diagram and collect config screenshots.

alice: I'll review privacy/legal/compliance (Q171-Q230) and flag anything that needs legal sign-off.

ana: @mike @sophia please confirm if you can surface the artifacts as PDFs/screenshots; customer won't accept raw links to internal consoles.

mike: Yep. I'll export the KMS policy as PDF and redact any ARNs that are customer-specific. For encryption-at-rest (Q12) I'll attach: 1) KMS policy, 2) storage config snippet, 3) short attestation.

sophia: For Q42 (console setting toggle), I need someone to grab a screenshot of the 'private deployment' toggle in the staging account. @mike can you take that?

mike: On it. Will upload to the secure evidence bucket and post the signed filename here.

sig-bot: Reminder: please upload artifacts to the secure evidence bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/acme-bank/SIG-2026/ and set ACL to redwood-evidence-readonly.

ana: Draft answers are in the shared drive — please comment inline. Link: https://drive.google.com/example/Acme/SIG-2026-DRAFT (team-only).

sophia: Quick note on Q98 (KV cache and session handling): short sample config below — please review and approve for submission.

```yaml
session_cache:
  type: redis
  ttl_seconds: 3600
  encrypted: true
```

mike: Looks good. For Q120 (network segmentation) I'll attach the VPC diagram + subnet table (CIDR ranges redacted).

alice: FYI customer asked about data residency (Q200). Please include our EU-region deployment option and a statement about data-at-rest locations. I'll draft the statement and push to the drive.

ana: There are two gating items: 1) customer asked for a SOC2 summary document they can add to their vendor portal; 2) they asked whether we can provide a private deployment POC timeline (they want 2-week POC).

mike: SOC2 summary — I'll attach the standard PDF. POC timeline — @sophia can you confirm feasibility for a 2-week Private deployment trial?

sophia: 2-week POC is tight but doable if we scope to a single model + one VPC. I'll draft a runbook and estimate; ETA EOD tomorrow.

ana: Action items recap: 1) mike -> infra artifacts + KMS PDF + network diagram; 2) sophia -> deployment screenshots + runbook for 2-week POC; 3) alice -> legal statement for residency + review Q171-Q230; 4) all -> comment on drive draft. Deadline: Thursday EOD for internal review so we can send finalized package Friday.

mike: Assigned Q1-Q85 in the draft. I'll upload s3://redwood-evidence/acme-bank/SIG-2026/mike-infra-package.pdf when done.

sophia: Assigned Q86-Q170. I'll post links to screenshots and the runbook here once uploaded.

alice: I'll run a quick legal sweep and flag any redlines by Thursday AM.

ana: Thanks team — I'll coordinate with Acme's security contact after we have the internal package. Please ping here if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
